paraphrase: Whatever composes a composite, uniting into one things that are plural in themselves, is an efficient cause of that composite, with no claim about when it causes. Time-neutral: unlike STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-IS-EFFICIENT, it does not say that the composer is an efficient cause here and now (DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING). Encoded as an independent temporally unspecified attribution in ComposerTemporalDefinitionFork.AttributedComposer. Its efficient-activity-at-a-time calibrations are separate OPEN propositions; neither existential temporal production nor selected-time sustaining is silently identified with this source statement.
